# Twittence

> AI visibility audit that scores websites across SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO
> (Generative Engine Optimization), and cross-platform sentiment, then runs a self-healing agent to
> find gaps, generate fixes, and verify results.

Twittence measures whether a page is actually structured to be cited by AI search systems — Google
AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude — not just how well it ranks in traditional search. Scoring
covers direct-answer structure, information gain, schema clarity, authority and entity signals
(including AI crawler access via robots.txt and Wikipedia/Wikidata presence), scannability, and
content freshness.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://twittence.com/): overview, live audit tool, pricing-free signup
- [How It Works](https://twittence.com/#how): the audit process
- [Live Citation Tracking](https://twittence.com/#audit-section): checks whether a page is currently
  cited in Google AI Overview results

## Documentation

- [Scoring Methodology](https://github.com/shams96/twittence/blob/main/docs/scoring-methodology.md):
  the exact weights and thresholds used for every pillar score
